body.title: migration(forgejo): migrate reactions and reviews
body.body:
- Forgejo advertises pre-release version (eg [`17.0.0-26-363f3dc30b+gitea-1.22.0`](https://code.forgejo.org/api/v1/version)). 
- Such pre-releases version never fullfix the `hashicorp/go-version.Constraints.Check` used by `gitea_sdk.Client.CheckServerVersionConstraint`.

Hence migration from a Forgejo host (like codeberg) would wrongly skip reactions and reviews (and use a weaker pagination)

This fixes this, by using `Version.GreaterThanOrEqual` instead.
